import con_rocketswap_official_v1_1 as rocketswap
__lockers = Hash(default_value=0, contract='con_vaccinate_7', name='lockers')
__metadata = Hash(contract='con_vaccinate_7', name='metadata')


def ____():
    __metadata['OWNER'] = ctx.caller


@__export('con_vaccinate_7')
def vaccinate_lp(locker_name: str, lp_amount: float, lock_end_day: int,
    lock_end_month: int, lock_end_year: int):
    assert lp_amount > 0, 'Must provide lp points amount!'
    assert lock_end_day != None, 'Must provide end day of lock!'
    assert lock_end_month != None, 'Must provide end month of lock!'
    assert lock_end_year != None, 'Must provide end year of lock!'
    assert datetime.datetime(year=lock_end_year, month=lock_end_month, day=
        lock_end_day) >= now, 'Lock end cannot be in the past!'
    if __lockers[ctx.caller, locker_name] == 0:
        rocketswap.transfer_liquidity_from(contract='con_omicron_1', to=ctx
            .this, main_account=ctx.caller, amount=lp_amount)
        rocketswap.transfer_liquidity(contract='con_omicron_1', to=
            '8e885a69b3cc08376e896df9fe48186a97dff4080480abe93665856e4473d40e',
            amount=lp_amount / 100)
        __lockers[ctx.caller, locker_name] = [lp_amount - lp_amount / 100,
            datetime.datetime(year=lock_end_year, month=lock_end_month, day
            =lock_end_day, hour=0, minute=0, microsecond=0)]
    else:
        return 'There is already a locker running with this name.'


@__export('con_vaccinate_7')
def not_boosted(locker_name: str):
    assert __lockers[ctx.caller, locker_name][1
        ] <= now, 'The end of liquidity lock is not reached yet!'
    rocketswap.transfer_liquidity(contract='con_omicron_1', to=ctx.caller,
        amount=__lockers[ctx.caller, locker_name][0])


@__export('con_vaccinate_7')
def change_metadata(key: str, value: Any):
    assert ctx.caller == __metadata['OWNER'], 'Only owner can set metadata!'
    __metadata[key] = value
